title: feat(app-shell): metadata list 修改时间 column and unpublished-changes mark (objectstack#36898)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB2BRcLs2zJH6mZWG94VVuew)_

Fixes #36898

Part of #36890

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

The widening: `MetadataListAnswer`, exported from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s entry, gains an optional `changedAt` member (an addition to that published package's public surface; precedents 36011-restore-factory-view, #36846). No metadata an author writes changes, so `Metadata-protocol: none` and the patch level stand. Corrected in round 2 per L1-b (3) S1 (7133485320).

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgNtKtppbRbXmHGH8x

## 维护者速读

- 搭建者在 Studio 和设置的元数据列表里，多了「修改时间」一列，可按它排序；有草稿的项下面标出「有未发布的改动」，AI 写的草稿单独标成「AI 的改动未发布」。
- 属于「Studio 重构」专题的列表部分，替搭建者回答「哪些项最近改过、哪些还没发布」。
- 出错时最多是时间显示为空或标记不显示，不影响打开、编辑和发布；可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- **「修改时间」 column** on the generic metadata list (Setup's catalog lists and Studio's "All metadata" area), read off the list answer's `changedAt` sibling (`GetMetaItemsResponseSchema.changedAt`, served since the list-response change for the card that added it). An item served from a stored row shows its time in the reader's locale (full instant on hover); a code-shipped item shows the empty-value dash, never an error.
- **Sortable**: new sort key `changed` in `metadataListState.ts` (the seam the list-state change left): "修改时间（最新在前）" / "（最早在前）", in the address as `sort=-changed` / `sort=changed`. Items without a time sort last in both directions; ties read A to Z by name. `orderedListNames` runs the same `applyListState`, and the detail side (`useListOrderedNames`) now reads the same times, so ‹ › follow the drawn order (pinned).
- **「有未发布的改动」 mark** beneath the time, from the existing `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts` ledger — no protocol change; drafts that existed before this change are marked too (epic decision 14). Measured: Studio's `StudioPendingDraftsContext` wraps the area's list but not Setup's, and its rows carry no package or bundle member, so the list reads the ledger through its own metadata client (`listDrafts`, the read the client's draft reads already ask first; same scope as the list's items), re-read with the list and on the publish pulse (`emitMetadataRefresh`).
- **AI vs person**: each marked item's strict draft read (`getDraft`, `draftChanges`) judged with `isAgentDraftSurface` — the rule `StudioAiDraftNotice`'s line uses (copilot or MCP build door ⇒ 「AI 的改动未发布」, violet with a sparkle; anything else or no recorded provenance ⇒ 「有未发布的改动」, amber). Not forked.
- **Client reader**: `MetadataClient.listResponse` dropped `changedAt`; it now carries it (each entry parsed with the spec's own rule; absence stays absence). `list` unchanged; `list` and `listResponse` share one in-flight GET (measured in the browser: one `/meta/dashboard` request per list load).
- New modules, each with its own test file named for the card: `listChangedAt.ts` (cell value, comparison, read hook), `listDraftMarks.ts` (ledger match + AI judgement + hook), `ListChangedCell.tsx` (the cell). Mounted in `ResourceListPage.tsx` with one header cell, one body cell and the reader member (15 lines) so the ObjectGrid re-host can move them as they are. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` untouched.

## Screenshots (real boot, showcase app, deviceScaleFactor 2)

Own backend on a random port, Console from this branch's `ui/` via Vite. Data written for real: a live save of `showcase_revenue_pulse` into `com.example.showcase.custom`; a person's draft (`surface=studio`) of `showcase_ops_dashboard`; an AI draft of `showcase_chart_gallery` saved through the MCP build door (`save_metadata_draft` with an OAuth token, `draftChanges[].by = mcp`).

Both mark kinds and a time; code-shipped items empty:

![both marks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/e80fcad491afd16c1c730f1873cc5834dcc08a74/issue-36898/before-publish.png)

Sorted newest first (`?sort=-changed`), items without a time last:

![sort newest first](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/e80fcad491afd16c1c730f1873cc5834dcc08a74/issue-36898/sort-newest.png)

After publishing the AI draft: its mark is gone and its time appears at the top:

![after publish](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/e80fcad491afd16c1c730f1873cc5834dcc08a74/issue-36898/after-publish.png)

![after publish, whole page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/e80fcad491afd16c1c730f1873cc5834dcc08a74/issue-36898/after-publish-page.png)

## Tests

Run on head `3671d2304` (after merging origin/main):

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the four new test files, `metadata-client.listRegistrations-12349`, `metadataListState-36896`, `useListScrollRestore-36896` and every `ResourceListPage.*` test: **Test Files 19 passed (19), Tests 130 passed (130)**.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0 (all three scripts echoed).

<details><summary>Ablations (one-off, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored and blob-verified)</summary>

- `listChangedAt.ts` missing-last flipped (`ta === null ? 1 : -1` → `-1 : 1`): 4 red — both sort-direction cases, the unparseable-time case, and the page's `?sort=-changed` order. Restored blob 8212f4df4d0a = before.
- `listDraftMarks.ts` AI judgement removed (`some(() => false)`): 2 red — the copilot/MCP case and the page's AI-vs-person mark. Restored blob 9d8aae37116f = before.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A person's **draft** save does not move the time: the list serves the published row (`changedAt` is that row's time); the mark shows instead, and the time moves on publish (screenshot 3). A live save moves the time at once (`showcase_revenue_pulse`).
- An item that exists only as a never-published draft is not on the plain list at all, so it has no row to mark; unchanged by this card.
- Bundle types: a row that declares no member matches a draft of any member of its name (the canonical member's spelling is not known to the list).
- Line budget: 734 changed lines vs the ~600 S-card guide — about 400 source/locale/changeset lines and 335 test lines. Reported rather than trimmed.

## Verification

Two-minute check: open `/studio/PACKAGE/metadata/dashboard` for a package with one stored item and one drafted item — the 修改时间 column shows the stored item's time, the drafted one carries 「有未发布的改动」; pick 「修改时间（最新在前）」 and the stored item moves to the top.

Read first (by risk): `listDraftMarks.ts` (ledger match across a base and its `.custom` pair), `metadataListState.ts` (the `changed` sort branch), `metadata-client.ts` (`readChangedAt`).

Overlap: `ResourceListPage.tsx` conflicts textually with the ObjectGrid swap's PR (#36978, head 1137895db4); declared in both claims — whichever lands second merges the other. Its list-row test selector was checked against this branch's new test ids (they do not start with `metadata-row-`).
